policy.scope: Every known missing mainstream sports set from 2000-2026 plus every known pre-2000 sports set identity without checklist rows.
policy.communitySources: Reddit, Blowout Forums, TCDB, and shared spreadsheets are discovery leads only until provenance and redistribution permission are confirmed.
policy.dedupe: Exact set keys are unique. Recovered source files are hashed and source items are deduplicated before catalog merge.
policy.completeness: The crawler also runs broad vintage decade-by-sport discovery queries to identify additional pre-2000 set identities not yet in the master catalog.
